title: Gran Tierra Energy Inc. Announces Ratification of its Onshore Exploration, Development and Production Sharing Agreement in Azerbaijan – Gran Tierra Energy

# PRESS RELEASE


5 October 2026


### Gran Tierra Energy Inc. Announces Ratification of its Onshore Exploration, Development and Production Sharing Agreement in Azerbaijan


CALGARY, Alberta, Oct. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Gran Tierra Energy Inc. (“Gran Tierra” or the “Company”) (NYSE American:GTE)(TSX:GTE)(LSE:GTE) is pleased to announce that the Milli Majlis, the Parliament of the Republic of Azerbaijan, has ratified the exploration, development and production sharing agreement (the “ **EDPSA** ”) for the onshore Guba-Khazaryani region (the “ **Contract Area** ”) that the Company signed with the State Oil Company of the Republic of Azerbaijan on February 18, 2026.


“We would like to thank our partner, the State Oil Company of the Republic of Azerbaijan, the Government of the Republic of Azerbaijan and all of its agencies involved in the ratification process, and the Milli Majlis for their hard work and commitment in passing this bill during the first plenary session of the autumn term,” said Gary Guidry, President and Chief Executive Officer of Gran Tierra.


**Airborne dFTG Program Update**


Gran Tierra has completed the flying of its airborne digital full tensor gradiometry (“ **dFTG** ”) survey in Azerbaijan. Gran Tierra flew 102 lines for 5,775-line kilometers, covering a total area of 4,815 square kilometers. The dFTG information will be used to help define the geometry of sedimentary basins and fault-related structures that potentially trap oil and gas in the Contract Area. This information will be integrated with existing seismic and exploratory well data to optimize the selection of future seismic acquisition areas and exploration and appraisal drilling locations.

**About** **Gran** **Tierra** **Energy** **Inc.**


Gran Tierra Energy Inc., together with its subsidiaries, is an independent international energy company currently focused on oil and natural gas exploration and production in Canada, Colombia and Ecuador. The Company is the operator of, and holds a 65% working interest in, an onshore exploration, development and production sharing agreement in Azerbaijan. Upon completion of the previously announced sale of its Colombian and Ecuadorian businesses (the “Sale”), the Company’s operations will be focused on Canada and Azerbaijan, and the Company will continue to pursue additional new growth opportunities that would further strengthen the Company’s portfolio. The Company’s common stock trades on the NYSE American, the Toronto Stock Exchange and the London Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol GTE.
